title: Telecom - Service Triage
description: Where is it broken? Read top to bottom: edge/API, database, queue producer, consumer. The first layer that looks wrong is usually the culprit.

panels.title: At a glance (one tile per layer)
Targets up
panels.description: Share of scrape targets that are up (pods running and reachable).

panels.title: Consumer receiving/s
panels.description: Layer 4. Orange while idle; compare with events produced.

panels.title: Failure injection
panels.description: 1 = a deliberate failure test is running.

panels.title: Responses by status code
panels.description: 5xx = server errors. 4xx are client mistakes (e.g. unknown subscriber).

panels.title: p95 latency by route
panels.description: Is one endpoint slow, or all of them?

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: Rising while CPU stays low usually means requests are waiting on something (a dependency, or injected latency).

panels.title: Query p95 by service and operation
Connections in use (app pool)
panels.description: Pool exhaustion shows up here before it shows up as errors. Add the CloudWatch RDS panels on EKS (CPU, connections, latency).

panels.title: Alert events produced
panels.description: Business view: how many 80% / 100% alerts the API is producing.

panels.title: Produced vs consumed
panels.description: Consumer line flat at zero while produced is above zero = stuck consumer, even if every pod is green.

panels.title: Processed by result
panels.description: sent / duplicate are healthy. delivery_failed / invalid / error are retried and end in the dead-letter queue.

panels.title: Worker heartbeat age
panels.description: Seconds since the consumer loop last iterated. Liveness restarts the pod if this exceeds 60 s.

panels.title: On EKS: add the queue's own metrics

options.content:
SQS depth and age come from CloudWatch, not from the app.

Add panels with the Grafana **CloudWatch** data source:

- `AWS/SQS` `ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage` (queue)
- `AWS/SQS` `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible` (queue and **dead-letter queue**)
- `AWS/RDS` `CPUUtilization`, `DatabaseConnections`

Alert on queue **age** and on DLQ depth > 0.

panels.title: Failure injection active
panels.description: Purple markers on every graph show when a test was running.

panels.title: Targets up
panels.description: 1 = scraped successfully. A gap or 0 here = pod down or restarting.
